Lemma
[Barrier functions for the perturbed quadratic] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0310 ↗ lem:chow-ii-harnack-exhaustion-function 1. ch15:15.23\group Noncompact Harnack Argument

Given $C,\eta >0$ and compact $\Omega \subset \mathcal M$, there are smooth positive $\phi (x,t)$, $\psi (t)$ such that $\phi ,\psi \le \eta $ on $\Omega \times [0,T]$, $\phi \to \infty $ at spatial infinity, and \[ (\nabla _t-\Delta )\phi >C\phi ,\qquad \partial _t\psi >C\psi , \qquad \phi \ge C\psi . \]
Proof

\sketch With $h$ from Lemma 4, take $\phi =\varepsilon e^{At}h$ and $\psi =\delta e^{Bt}$. Choose $A,B>C$, then choose $\varepsilon $ small enough on $\Omega $, and finally $\delta $ small enough that $\psi \le \eta $ and $C\psi \le \phi $. The derivative inequalities follow from $h\ge 1$ and $\Delta h\le C$.
